title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization

paragraphs.en: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathmatically rigorours tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. AgenticBBO-Bench provides a common standardized leaderboard for comparing future general-purpose models and agent systems, sheding the light towards universal BBO via agentic operations. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo .

paragraphs.en: Black-box optimization (BBO) considers optimization problems where the objective function can be evaluated, but its analytical form and gradients are unavailable ( Shahriari et al., 2016 ; Frazier, 2018 ) . It has been widely used in applications including chemical design ( Hase et al., 2018 ) , materials optimization ( Frazier and Wang, 2016 ) , and complex system configuration ( Golovin et al., 2017 ) , where each objective evaluation can be expensive. Classical BBO methods, such as Bayesian optimization ( Garnett, 2023 ) and evolutionary algorithms ( Eiben and Smith, 2015 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ) , mainly operate on numerical observations. Their search behavior is determined by predefined heuristics like surrogate models, acquisition functions, or search operators ( Jones et al., 1998 ; Srinivas et al., 2010 ; Hansen, 2016 ) . However, real optimization problems often come with additional information beyond numerical observations, such as task descriptions, variable semantics, and domain knowledge. LLMs provide a natural way to exploit such information alongside the numerical search history ( Song et al., 2024 ) . This has motivated a growing line of LLM-based BBO methods that use language models to propose candidate solutions, model the objective, or support specific stages of the optimization process ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Ran et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 黑箱优化（BBO）处理的是这类优化问题：目标函数可以被评估，但其解析形式和梯度却无法获取（Shahriari 等人，2016；Frazier，2018）。 该方法已被广泛应用于多种场景，包括化学设计（Hase 等人，2018）、材料优化（Frazier 和 Wang，2016）以及复杂系统配置（Golovin 等人，2017），在这些场景中，每次目标函数评估都可能成本高昂。 经典的 BBO 方法，例如贝叶斯优化（Garnett，2023）和进化算法（Eiben 和 Smith，2015；Zhou 等人，2019），主要基于数值观测结果进行运作。 它们的搜索行为由预先定义的启发式规则决定，例如代理模型、获取函数或搜索算子（Jones 等人，1998；Srinivas 等人，2010；Hansen，2016）。 然而，真实的优化问题通常包含超出数值观测结果的额外信息，例如任务描述、变量语义和领域知识。 大语言模型（LLM）为结合数值搜索历史来利用此类信息提供了一种自然的方式（Song 等人，2024）。 这促使了基于 LLM 的 BBO 方法不断涌现，这些方法利用语言模型来提出候选解、建模目标函数或支持优化过程中的特定阶段（Yang 等人，2024；Liu 等人，2024；Ran 等人，2025；Tan 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Although LLMs have been incorporated into different stages of BBO, they are typically used as fixed components of the optimization procedure. At each round, the surrounding algorithm invokes the LLM to perform a predefined operation, such as generating the next candidate, while the rest of the optimization loop is specified in advance ( Schwanke et al., 2026 ; Meindl et al., 2025 ) . Recent work has begun to move toward a more agentic formulation ( Maus et al., 2026 ; Brunzema et al., 2026 ; Suwandi, 2026 ) , in which the LLM interacts with an optimization environment rather than serving as a single fixed operator. Before submitting a candidate, the LLM can inspect the search state, execute code, invoke some domain-specific tools, observe their outputs, and decide what action to take next. Crucially, the sequence of these intermediate actions is determined online by the LLM rather than prescribed by the optimization algorithm. We refer to this setting as Agentic BBO .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已被整合到生物启发式优化（BBO）的不同阶段，但它们通常被用作优化过程中的固定组件。 在每一轮中，外围算法会调用 LLM 执行预定义的操作，例如生成下一个候选解，而优化循环的其他部分则是预先指定的（Schwanke 等人，2026；Meindl 等人，2025）。 近期的研究开始转向更具智能体特性的框架（Maus 等人，2026；Brunzema 等人，2026；Suwandi，2026），其中 LLM 与优化环境进行交互，而非仅仅作为一个单一的固定操作单元。 在提交候选解之前，LLM 可以检查搜索状态、执行代码、调用某些领域专用工具、观察其输出，并决定接下来采取何种行动。 关键在于，这些中间动作的顺序是由 LLM 在线决定的，而非由优化算法预先规定。 我们将这种设定称为“智能体式生物启发式优化”（Agentic BBO）。

paragraphs.en: Placing the LLM in this agentic role also makes comparisons between methods less direct. The resulting search behavior depends not only on the optimization problem, but also on what information the agent observes, which tools it can access, and how the surrounding harness manages its interaction with the environment. Similar sensitivity to the agent harness has also been observed in general LLM-agent evaluation ( Kapoor et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Existing Agentic BBO studies make different choices along these dimensions and are typically evaluated within individual domains, making their results difficult to compare. Recent benchmarks have begun to standardize evaluation within specific settings, such as sequential hyperparameter optimization ( Huai et al., 2026 ) , but a systematic comparison across heterogeneous BBO problems is still missing. As a result, it remains unclear which findings reflect general properties of Agentic BBO and which depend on a particular task or system design.
paragraphs.zh: 将大型语言模型置于这种智能体角色中，也使得不同方法之间的比较变得不那么直接。 由此产生的搜索行为不仅取决于优化问题，还取决于智能体观察到的信息、它能使用的工具，以及周围的运行环境如何管理它与环境的交互。 在一般的大型语言模型-智能体评估中，也观察到了对智能体运行环境的类似敏感性（Kapoor 等，2026；Yao 等，2026）。 现有的智能体强化贝叶斯优化研究在这些维度上做出了不同的选择，并且通常在特定领域内进行评估，这使得其结果难以比较。 近期的基准测试已开始在某些特定设置中标准化评估，例如序列超参数优化（Huai 等，2026），但跨异构贝叶斯优化问题的系统性比较仍然缺失。 因此，目前尚不清楚哪些发现反映了智能体强化贝叶斯优化的普遍特性，而哪些又取决于特定的任务或系统设计。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in finite-budget black-box optimization. It covers five established settings: synthetic numerical optimization from BBOB ( Hansen et al., 2021 ) , hyperparameter optimization from Bayesmark ( Turner et al., 2021 ) , database tuning ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , chip design (specifically macro placement) from BBOPlace-Bench ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , and molecular design from GuacaMol ( Brown et al., 2019 ) . Together, these domains span continuous, mixed, and structured search spaces, with different task semantics and feasibility constraints. We place them under a common finite-budget protocol, enabling general-purpose agents and domain-specific optimizers—including TuRBO ( Eriksson et al., 2019 ) for continuous BBO, TPE ( Bergstra et al., 2011 ) for hyperparameter optimization, and Graph-GA ( Jensen, 2019 ) for molecular design—to be compared under consistent evaluation rules.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 AgenticBBO-Bench——一个用于评估有限预算黑盒优化中 LLM 智能体的跨领域基准。 该基准涵盖五个成熟的场景：来自 BBOB（Hansen 等人，2021）的合成数值优化、来自 Bayesmark（Turner 等人，2021）的超参数优化、数据库调优（Zhang 等人，2022）、来自 BBOPlace-Bench（Xue 等人，2026）的芯片设计（具体为宏布局），以及来自 GuacaMol（Brown 等人，2019）的分子设计。 这些领域共同覆盖了连续、混合和结构化的搜索空间，并具有不同的任务语义和可行性约束。 我们将它们置于统一的有限预算协议之下，从而使得通用智能体与领域专用优化器——包括用于连续 BBO 的 TuRBO（Eriksson 等人，2019）、用于超参数优化的 TPE（Bergstra 等人，2011）以及用于分子设计的 Graph-GA（Jensen，2019）——能够在一致的评估规则下进行比较。

sents.en: We place them under a common finite-budget protocol, enabling general-purpose agents and domain-specific optimizers—including TuRBO ( Eriksson et al., 2019 ) for continuous BBO, TPE ( Bergstra et al., 2011 ) for hyperparameter optimization, and Graph-GA ( Jensen, 2019 ) for molecular design—to be compared under consistent evaluation rules.
sents.zh: 我们将它们置于统一的有限预算协议之下，从而使得通用智能体与领域专用优化器——包括用于连续 BBO 的 TuRBO（Eriksson 等人，2019）、用于超参数优化的 TPE（Bergstra 等人，2011）以及用于分子设计的 Graph-GA（Jensen，2019）——能够在一致的评估规则下进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the benchmark comparison, we use controlled experiments to study three factors that shape Agentic BBO performance: optimization tools, task information, and the degree of LLM involvement in the optimization loop. Our analysis reveals several findings. Providing additional numerical tools does not consistently improve performance, while access to task semantics is broadly beneficial. More specific prior knowledge is less reliable, and its value depends strongly on the problem. We also observe that the LLM can play different roles over the course of optimization, with numerical methods sometimes continuing effectively from an agent-guided search.
paragraphs.zh: 除了基准测试比较之外，我们还通过受控实验研究了影响智能体 BBO 性能的三个因素：优化工具、任务信息以及 LLM 在优化循环中的参与程度。 我们的分析揭示了几项发现。 提供额外的数值工具并不总能提升性能，而获取任务语义则普遍有益。 更具体的先验知识可靠性较低，其价值在很大程度上取决于具体问题。 我们还观察到，在整个优化过程中，LLM 可以扮演不同的角色，有时数值方法能够延续智能体引导的搜索并持续有效运行。

paragraphs.en: 1) We introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for Agentic BBO that covers five representative optimization domains under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol.

paragraphs.en: Different BBO methods implement this decision in different ways. Classical methods largely specify the search procedure in advance: random search samples from a predefined distribution, evolutionary algorithms apply predefined selection and variation operators, and Bayesian optimization selects candidates using a surrogate model and acquisition rule ( Bergstra et al., 2011 ; Snoek et al., 2012 ; Bull, 2011 ) . Learning-to-optimize methods instead learn part or all of this decision rule from previously solved, related, or synthetic optimization tasks ( Volpp et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Large language models further broaden the information that can influence the search by allowing optimizers to condition on task descriptions, variable semantics, documentation, constraints, and other forms of prior knowledge that are difficult to encode in a fixed numerical representation ( Brahmachary et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Ranković et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 不同的 BBO 方法以不同方式实现这一决策。 经典方法大多预先规定了搜索过程：随机搜索从预定义分布中采样，进化算法应用预定义的选择和变异算子，而贝叶斯优化则利用代理模型和获取规则来选择候选解（Bergstra et al., 2011；Snoek et al., 2012；Bull, 2011）。 相比之下，“学习以优化”方法会从先前已解决的、相关的或合成的优化任务中学习部分或全部决策规则（Volpp et al., 2020；Chen et al., 2022；Li et al., 2025）。 大型语言模型进一步扩展了能够影响搜索的信息范围，使优化器能够基于任务描述、变量语义、文档、约束以及难以用固定数值表示编码的其他形式先验知识进行条件判断（Brahmachary et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025；Ranković et al., 2026；Sun et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Under this view, a classical BBO optimizer is only one possible tool available to the agent. The agent may query it for suggestions or predictions, modify or ignore its outputs, and combine them with other information before selecting the next candidate. Recent agentic BO systems similarly expose numerical optimizers as tools while leaving the final candidate choice to the agent ( Brunzema et al., 2026 ) . More importantly, the agent is also not limited to tools provided in advance: it can write code and build its own task-specific analyses or optimization tools during the search.

sents.zh: 近期的智能体式贝叶斯优化系统同样将数值优化器作为工具提供，但最终候选方案的选择仍由智能体决定（Brunzema 等人，2026）。

sents.en: More importantly, the agent is also not limited to tools provided in advance: it can write code and build its own task-specific analyses or optimization tools during the search.
sents.zh: 更重要的是，智能体也不仅限于预先提供的工具：它可以在搜索过程中编写代码，并构建专用于特定任务的分析或优化工具。

paragraphs.en: This added flexibility means that evaluating Agentic BBO requires considering the full agent system, not just the underlying LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 这种新增的灵活性意味着，评估智能体式 BBO 需要考虑整个智能体系统，而不仅仅是底层的 LLM。

paragraphs.en: In practice, an Agentic BBO system is determined not only by the underlying LLM, but also by the task information provided to it, the agent harness that manages its interaction and state, and the tools and numerical backends it can access. Together, these choices determine what the agent can observe and what actions it can take before each evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，一个智能体 BBO 系统不仅由底层的 LLM 决定，还取决于向其提供的任务信息、管理其交互和状态的智能体框架，以及它能够访问的工具和数值后端。 这些选择共同决定了在每次评估之前，该智能体能够观察到什么以及可以执行哪些操作。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating Agentic BBO therefore requires considering the entire agent system rather than the language model alone. Even with the same underlying model, changing the harness, task information, or available tools can lead to different optimization behaviors. Similar effects have been observed for general LLM agents, where performance can vary substantially across model–harness configurations ( Kapoor et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Existing Agentic BBO methods also differ in the tasks and evaluation settings they use, making their reported results difficult to compare directly. End-to-end performance alone therefore does not reveal whether a difference comes from the agent design, the task being optimized, or the evaluation setup.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，评估智能体式 BBO 需要考虑整个智能体系统，而不仅仅是语言模型本身。 即使使用相同的底层模型，改变封装框架、任务信息或可用工具也可能导致不同的优化行为。 在通用 LLM 智能体中也观察到了类似效应：不同模型与封装框架的配置组合可能导致性能存在显著差异（Kapoor 等，2026；Yao 等，2026）。 现有的智能体式 BBO 方法在使用的任务和评估设置上也存在差异，这使得其报告的结果难以直接比较。 因此，仅凭端到端性能无法判断差异究竟源于智能体设计、被优化的任务，还是评估设置本身。

paragraphs.en: These issues motivate two goals for our benchmark: enabling fair comparison across diverse BBO tasks and supporting controlled analysis of the components that shape agent behavior. We therefore use a unified black-box interaction and evaluation protocol across tasks, while varying task information, optimization tools, and the degree of LLM control. This allows us to compare complete Agentic BBO systems under the same setting and to study how individual design choices affect optimization performance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题促使我们为基准测试设定了两个目标：实现多样化 BBO 任务之间的公平比较，并支持对塑造智能体行为的各个组件进行受控分析。 因此，我们在所有任务中采用统一的黑箱交互与评估协议，同时变化任务信息、优化工具以及 LLM 控制的程度。 这使得我们能够在相同设置下比较完整的智能体 BBO 系统，并研究各项设计选择如何影响优化性能。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate optimization performance over the full best-so-far trajectory rather than only the final solution. Following the normalized anytime evaluation protocol used in RSI-Exam ( RSI-Exam Team, 2026 ) , we combine performance throughout the optimization process with the quality of the final solution. Specifically, we combine the average normalized best-so-far quality over the optimization trajectory with the normalized quality of the final best solution, assigning 70% and 30% weights, respectively. Since objective scales differ across tasks, the best-so-far value at each evaluation step is first converted to a normalized quality q ⁡ ( ⋅ ) q(\cdot) . The task-specific normalization rules and reference construction are detailed in Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估优化性能时，会考察整个“迄今为止最佳”的轨迹，而不仅仅是最终解。 遵循 RSI-Exam（RSI-Exam Team, 2026）中使用的归一化随时评估协议，我们将整个优化过程中的性能与最终解的质量相结合。 具体而言，我们将优化轨迹上“迄今为止最佳”解的平均归一化质量与最终最佳解的归一化质量相结合，分别赋予 70% 和 30% 的权重。 由于不同任务的目标函数尺度存在差异，因此在每个评估步骤中，“迄今为止最佳”值会先被转换为归一化质量 q⁡(⋅) q(\cdot)。 特定任务的归一化规则与参考构造详见附录 A.3。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we evaluate Agentic BBO across a broad set of black-box optimization tasks and analyze the factors that shape its performance. Section 5.1 describes the experimental setup, and Section 5.2 presents the main benchmark comparison against direct LLM optimization and representative numerical optimizers. paragraphs.en: We use DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the default backbone and Codex as the agent harness. Direct receives the task description and optimization history in context and directly generates the next candidate, whereas Agentic operates in a persistent workspace with Bash/Python, structured access to the search state, and candidate-submission interfaces. All comparisons follow the unified protocol in Section 4 with matched initialization and evaluation budgets. For the ablation studies on benchmark tasks, we draw different task subsets from a common eight-task pool, with two tasks from each non-molecular benchmark family to balance cross-domain coverage and experimental cost. The exact task subset used in each experiment is listed in Appendix B.5 . Full task, budget, ablation, and implementation details are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 用作默认主干模型，并将 Codex 用作智能体框架。 Direct 在上下文中接收任务描述和优化历史，并直接生成下一个候选方案；而 Agentic 则在持久化的工作空间中运行，使用 Bash/Python、结构化的搜索状态访问接口以及候选方案提交接口。 所有比较均遵循第 4 节中的统一协议，且初始化预算和评估预算相匹配。 在基准任务的去活化研究中，我们从包含八个任务的公共任务池中抽取不同的任务子集，每个非分子类基准任务族选取两个任务，以平衡跨领域覆盖范围和实验成本。 每次实验中使用的具体任务子集列于附录 B.5 中。 完整任务、预算、去活化研究和实现细节均提供在附录 B 中。

paragraphs.en: Table 2(a) compares Direct and Agentic with representative numerical baselines across the five benchmark families. Agentic outperforms Direct on all five families, with an average relative improvement of 30.3% , and the largest improvements on BBOB, from 0.460 to 0.661 ( +43.7% ), and GuacaMol, from 0.565 to 0.840 ( +48.7% ). paragraphs.en: We next study whether numerical optimization tools improve Agentic BBO. Drawing on the tool interfaces in Sara’s framework ( Brunzema et al., 2026 ) , we adapt GP-based optimization tools to our benchmark and consider two augmentations of the base Agentic configuration. + GP Suggest adds a GP candidate-proposal interface, while + GP Tools additionally exposes surrogate prediction, acquisition scoring, diagnostics, and controls over the search region and acquisition policy. The agent remains free to accept, modify, or reject GP suggestions. All three configurations otherwise share the same agent environment and evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们研究数值优化工具是否能提升智能体 BBO。 借助 Sara 框架中的工具接口（Brunzema 等人，2026），我们将基于遗传规划（GP）的优化工具适配到我们的基准测试中，并考虑对基础智能体配置进行两种增强：+ GP Suggest 增加了一个 GP 候选提案接口，而 + GP Tools 则进一步开放了代理预测、获取评分、诊断功能，以及对搜索区域和获取策略的控制。 智能体仍然可以自由地接受、修改或拒绝 GP 的建议。 除此之外，这三种配置共享相同的智能体环境和评估协议。

paragraphs.en: To understand why, we examine how agents use Python and GP-based tools during optimization. Figure 3(a) shows that custom Python remains common even after GP tools are introduced: with + GP Tools , 35.4% of rounds use only Python and another 17.4% use both Python and GP tools. This suggests that agents do not simply hand the search over to the provided optimizer. Figure 3(b) gives a concrete example on the chip placement task Bigblue1: the agent fits a linear proxy from observed layouts, uses the learned pattern to construct a new placement, and continues refining it in later rounds, improving the best-so-far score from 0.551 after the first new evaluation to 0.664 after four evaluations and 0.676 eventually. This case suggests that custom Python allows the agent to build task-specific analyses from the observed trajectory, rather than relying on the fixed inductive bias of a fixed GP backend. This may explain why a fixed GP interface does not always benefit Agentic BBO, as the agent can already discover useful task-specific patterns from the search trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解其中的原因，我们研究了智能体在优化过程中如何使用 Python 和基于 GP 的工具。 图 3(a) 显示，即使引入了 GP 工具，自定义 Python 仍然被广泛使用：在使用 + GP Tools 的情况下，35.4% 的轮次仅使用 Python，另有 17.4% 的轮次同时使用 Python 和 GP 工具。 这表明智能体并未简单地将搜索任务完全交给所提供的优化器。 图 3(b) 在芯片布局任务 Bigblue1 上给出了一个具体示例：智能体从已观察到的布局中拟合出一个线性代理模型，利用学到的模式构建新的布局，并在后续轮次中持续进行优化，使当前最佳得分从首次新评估后的 0.551 提升至四次评估后的 0.664，最终达到 0.676。 这一案例表明，自定义 Python 使智能体能够基于观察到的轨迹构建任务特定的分析，而不是依赖固定 GP 后端所固有的归纳偏置。 这或许可以解释为何固定的 GP 接口并不总能对 Agentic BBO 产生帮助，因为智能体已经能够从搜索轨迹中发现有用的任务特定模式。

paragraphs.en: We next study how task information and prior knowledge affect Agentic BBO. On six real-world tasks, we compare Anonymous , which hides task and variable identities, Semantic , which restores task and parameter semantics, and Full Prior , which additionally provides domain knowledge. Figure 4(a) shows that semantics consistently help, raising the mean score from 0.465 to 0.595. Additional priors are less reliable: they improve Bigblue1 and Sysbench-5 but hurt PostgreSQL-5 and Adaptec1, reducing the mean to 0.569. This suggests that more detailed knowledge is not automatically useful.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们研究任务信息和先验知识如何影响智能体 BBO。 在六个真实世界任务中，我们比较了隐藏任务和变量身份的 Anonymous、恢复任务和参数语义的 Semantic，以及额外提供领域知识的 Full Prior。 图 4(a) 显示，语义信息始终有助于提升性能，将平均得分从 0.465 提高到 0.595。 额外的先验知识则可靠性较低：它们提升了 Bigblue1 和 Sysbench-5 的性能，但损害了 PostgreSQL-5 和 Adaptec1，使平均得分降至 0.569。 这表明更详细的知识并不一定自动带来好处。

paragraphs.en: To isolate what makes a prior effective, we construct three anonymous 12-dimensional objectives with four active variables and vary the information provided about their support and local geometry. Figure 4(b) shows that combining correct support with geometry performs best, increasing the mean score from 0.685 to 0.872. Either alone gives smaller gains, while replacing the support with an incorrect one reduces performance to 0.682, nearly removing the benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 为了明确先验有效性的关键因素，我们构建了三个匿名 12 维目标函数，其中包含四个活跃变量，并调整了关于其支撑集和局部几何结构所提供的信息。 图 4(b) 显示，将正确的支撑集与几何结构相结合的效果最佳，使平均得分从 0.685 提升至 0.872。 单独使用其中任何一种提升效果较小，而用错误的支撑集替代正确支撑集则会使性能降至 0.682，几乎完全消除了这种优势。

paragraphs.en: We next study where LLM control is most useful in the optimization loop. Table 3(a) compares full Agentic optimization with three alternatives: GP-policy control, numerical handoff after an agent warm-up, and offline optimizer development.

paragraphs.en: Restricting the LLM to controlling a GP policy lowers the score from 0.569 to 0.516, suggesting that its value extends beyond adjusting a fixed optimizer. In contrast, handing the search to TuRBO after the agent warm-up achieves 0.570, essentially matching continued Agentic optimization and clearly outperforming TuRBO started from the initial observations (0.475). Thus, the agent can provide a useful search prefix without remaining online for the full trajectory.

paragraphs.en: We finally evaluate seven frontier models on a common five-task challenge: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026a ) , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and DeepSeek V4 Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026b ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , GLM-5.3 ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , and Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: We introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in black-box optimization under a unified protocol. Across five optimization domains, Agentic configuration consistently improves over direct LLM optimization and is competitive with established numerical optimizers. Our controlled studies further show that additional optimization tools do not always improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can sometimes continue effectively from search trajectories established by the agent. We also establish a compact five-task frontier challenge for comparing future models and agent systems under the same setting. Together, these results provide a benchmark and empirical basis for studying how general-purpose agents can be used for black-box optimization. We discuss several directions for future Agentic BBO systems in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AgenticBBO-Bench，这是一个跨领域的基准测试，用于在统一协议下评估 LLM 智能体在黑盒优化中的表现。 在五个优化领域中，Agentic 配置始终优于直接的 LLM 优化方法，并与成熟的数值优化器具有竞争力。 我们的受控研究进一步表明：额外的优化工具并不总能提升性能；任务语义普遍有效，而更具体的先验知识则可靠性较低；数值优化器有时也能从智能体建立的搜索轨迹中继续有效执行。 我们还设计了一个包含五个任务的紧凑型前沿挑战，用于在相同设置下比较未来的模型和智能体系统。 综合来看，这些结果为一个基准测试以及研究通用型智能体如何应用于黑盒优化提供了实证基础。 我们在附录 C 中讨论了未来 Agentic BBO 系统的几个研究方向。

paragraphs.en: We construct the benchmark from five established task families covering synthetic numerical optimization, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design. Below we describe the source benchmark and evaluation setup for each family.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从五个成熟的任务家族中构建该基准测试，这些任务家族涵盖合成数值优化、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计和分子设计。 下面我们将分别描述每个任务家族的源基准测试和评估设置。

sents.en: We construct the benchmark from five established task families covering synthetic numerical optimization, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design.
sents.zh: 我们从五个成熟的任务家族中构建该基准测试，这些任务家族涵盖合成数值优化、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计和分子设计。

sents.en: Below we describe the source benchmark and evaluation setup for each family.
sents.zh: 下面我们将分别描述每个任务家族的源基准测试和评估设置。

paragraphs.en: We use the noiseless BBOB suite from COCO ( Hansen et al., 2021 ) . BBOB is a standard benchmark for continuous black-box optimization and has been widely used to evaluate Bayesian optimization and other derivative-free optimization methods ( Santoni et al., 2024 ) . Its functions cover a range of landscape properties, including separability, conditioning, variable interactions, and multimodality. The objective is evaluated directly using the corresponding analytic benchmark function.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 COCO 中的无噪声 BBOB 函数集（Hansen 等人，2021）。 BBOB 是连续黑箱优化的标准基准，已被广泛用于评估贝叶斯优化及其他无导数优化方法（Santoni 等人，2024）。 其函数涵盖了多种景观特性，包括可分离性、条件性、变量交互性和多模态性。 目标函数通过对应的解析基准函数直接进行评估。

sents.en: We use the noiseless BBOB suite from COCO ( Hansen et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用了 COCO 中的无噪声 BBOB 函数集（Hansen 等人，2021）。

paragraphs.en: We construct hyperparameter optimization tasks from Bayesmark ( Turner et al., 2021 ) . Each task specifies a machine-learning model, dataset, and mixed-type hyperparameter search space. A candidate corresponds to a complete hyperparameter configuration, and its objective value is determined by the predictive performance of the resulting model on the fixed task. HPO has also become a common setting for evaluating LLM-based optimization methods ( Huai et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Bayesmark（Turner 等人，2021）构建超参数优化任务。 每个任务都指定了一个机器学习模型、数据集和混合类型的超参数搜索空间。 一个候选方案对应于一个完整的超参数配置，其目标值由该配置所生成的模型在固定任务上的预测性能决定。 HPO 也成为评估基于 LLM 的优化方法的一种常见设置（Huai 等人，2026）。

sents.en: We construct hyperparameter optimization tasks from Bayesmark ( Turner et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 我们从 Bayesmark（Turner 等人，2021）构建超参数优化任务。

paragraphs.en: For database configuration tuning, we use the surrogate-based benchmark introduced by Zhang et al. (2022) . The search space consists of mixed-type database configuration knobs whose interactions can have substantial effects on system performance. To make repeated evaluation efficient and reproducible, the benchmark evaluates configurations using fixed learned surrogate models constructed from measurements of the underlying database system.
paragraphs.zh: 在数据库配置调优方面，我们使用了 Zhang 等人（2022）提出的代理模型基准测试。 搜索空间由混合类型的数据库配置参数组成，这些参数之间的相互作用可能对系统性能产生显著影响。 为了使重复评估既高效又可复现，该基准测试使用基于底层数据库系统测量结果构建的固定代理模型来评估各种配置。

paragraphs.en: We use macro-placement tasks derived from BBOPlace-Bench ( Xue et al., 2026 ) . A candidate specifies the positions of movable macros and is decoded into a physical placement before evaluation. The placement must satisfy task-specific physical constraints, and valid layouts are evaluated using the corresponding placement objective. Our experiments use the compact 32-macro setting, which provides a tractable but structurally constrained EDA optimization problem.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了源自 BBOPlace-Bench（Xue 等人，2026）的宏布局任务。 一个候选方案指定了可移动宏的位置，并在评估前被解码为物理布局。 该布局必须满足任务特定的物理约束，而有效的布局则通过相应的布局目标函数进行评估。 我们的实验采用了紧凑的 32 宏设置，该设置提供了一个易于处理但具有结构性约束的 EDA 优化问题。

paragraphs.en: We use goal-directed molecular optimization tasks from GuacaMol ( Brown et al., 2019 ) . Candidates are represented as SMILES strings and evaluated using task-specific molecular scoring functions. Unlike the vector-valued search spaces above, this setting requires optimization over structured discrete objects while maintaining chemical validity. GuacaMol has also been used in recent work on language-agent-based black-box optimization ( Maus et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了来自 GuacaMol（Brown 等人，2019）的目标导向型分子优化任务。 候选分子以 SMILES 字符串形式表示，并通过任务特定的分子评分函数进行评估。 与上述向量值搜索空间不同，这种设置需要在保持化学有效性的同时，对结构化的离散对象进行优化。 GuacaMol 也已被用于近期基于语言智能体的黑箱优化研究（Maus 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: All agentic methods interact with the benchmark through the same containerized workspace interface. Each run is executed in an isolated Docker container, where the agent can inspect benchmark-provided files, use native Bash and Python for analysis, and access benchmark operations through a shared workspace interface. The objective evaluator and other hidden task state remain host-managed and are not directly accessible from the container.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体方法都通过相同的容器化工作区接口与基准进行交互。 每次运行都在一个隔离的 Docker 容器中执行，其中智能体可以检查基准提供的文件，使用原生 Bash 和 Python 进行分析，并通过共享工作区接口访问基准操作。 目标评估器和其他隐藏的任务状态由主机管理，无法从容器内直接访问。

paragraphs.en: At the beginning of each run, the workspace contains a compact task card ( task.md ) and shared optimization instructions ( instructions.md ). paragraphs.en: Optimization proceeds in a persistent agent session. At each round, the agent receives the current evaluation state, may inspect any benchmark-visible information or perform local analysis, and then attempts to submit one legal candidate.

paragraphs.en: A submitted candidate is first validated by the host. If validation fails, the candidate is rejected without consuming objective budget, and the agent may revise and resubmit within the same round. Once a valid candidate is accepted, the round ends and the host evaluates the candidate. The resulting objective value is returned to the same persistent session at the beginning of the next round.
paragraphs.zh: 提交的候选项首先由主机进行验证。 如果验证失败，该候选项将被拒绝且不会消耗目标预算，智能体可以在同一轮次内修改后重新提交。 一旦有效的候选项被接受，该轮次即结束，主机将对候选项进行评估。 所得的目标值将在下一轮开始时分配给同一个持久化会话。

paragraphs.en: We consider two general-purpose agent configurations. Population-based methods may generate multiple internal candidates, but true objective evaluations are returned through the same host evaluation interface and truncated at the common budget.

Kernel and likelihood parameters are fitted from the accumulated observations throughout optimization. For acquisition optimization, we use a dimension-dependent candidate budget

paragraphs.en: For GuacaMol, where candidates are complete SMILES strings rather than vectors in a fixed-dimensional continuous space, we use two molecular optimization baselines. GPBO ( Tripp et al., 2021 ) represents molecules with Morgan fingerprints and fits a Tanimoto-kernel GP, with molecular candidates generated by a graph-based acquisition optimizer. Graph-GA ( Jensen, 2019 ) directly evolves molecular graphs. Both methods start from the same 50 evaluated molecules as the agent methods, and only molecules evaluated by the host objective may update the optimizer state or incumbent.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 GuacaMol，其候选分子是完整的 SMILES 字符串，而非固定维度连续空间中的向量，我们使用两种分子优化基线方法。 GPBO（Tripp 等人，2021）使用 Morgan 指纹表示分子，并拟合一个 Tanimoto 核高斯过程，其中分子候选体由基于图的获取优化器生成。 Graph-GA（Jensen，2019）直接演化分子图。 这两种方法都与智能体方法一样，从相同的 50 个已评估分子开始，并且只有由主目标函数评估的分子才能更新优化器的状态或当前最优解。

paragraphs.en: The complete 196-entry parameter catalog is retrieved on demand. The additional task context identifies the Sysbench workload and describes database mechanisms involving memory and caching, I/O, concurrency, query optimization, logging, replication, and authentication. For example, innodb_buffer_pool_size controls caching of data and index pages, innodb_thread_concurrency limits internal InnoDB concurrency, and innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit together with sync_binlog affects synchronization around commits.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的包含 196 个条目的参数目录会按需获取。 额外的任务上下文明确了 Sysbench 工作负载，并描述了涉及内存和缓存、I/O、并发、查询优化、日志记录、复制和身份验证的数据库机制。 例如，innodb_buffer_pool_size 控制数据和索引页面的缓存，innodb_thread_concurrency 限制 InnoDB 的内部并发，而 innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit 与 sync_binlog 共同影响提交操作周围的同步过程。

paragraphs.en: The retrievable task details describe both legalization and scoring. Submitted coordinates are first floored to the placement grid. paragraphs.zh: 可检索的任务细节同时描述了合法化与评分。 提交的坐标首先会被向下取整到放置网格上。 随后，一个仅基于几何形状的确定性修复过程会优先放置面积较大的宏单元，保留合法位置，并将冲突的宏单元沿物理曼哈顿距离移动到最近的合法位置，同时采用确定性方式解决平局情况。 合法化过程使用了宏单元的几何形状，但不会检查隐藏的网表或布线成本。

paragraphs.en: HPWL is evaluated only after the complete placement has been repaired. If legalization cannot complete, the host returns a fixed legal fallback layout together with its HPWL. paragraphs.zh: 只有在完整布局修复完成后，才会评估 HPWL。 如果合法性验证无法完成，主机将返回一个固定的合法备用布局及其对应的 HPWL。 任务上下文还告知智能体：每个宏的两个坐标是成对存在的，子网格的变化在取整后可能变得等价，并且坐标通过非重叠约束和互联引脚相互影响。 它提供了定性指导：较小的布线包围框可以降低 HPWL，而激进的聚类操作可能会触发合法性验证并导致其他宏发生位移。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments expose several open problems that go beyond the particular agents and optimizers evaluated in this benchmark. Rather than treating the current results as a final recipe for Agentic BBO, we highlight several directions for developing more general and effective optimization agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验揭示了一些开放性问题，这些问题超出了本基准测试中所评估的具体智能体和优化器。 我们并未将当前结果视为智能体 BBO 的最终方案，而是指出了若干发展更通用、更高效优化智能体的方向。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that the value of an optimization tool depends more on whether it matches the task than on how powerful the tool is in isolation. Recent agentic optimization systems have begun to expose numerical backends as tools that the agent can selectively query and control ( Brunzema et al., 2026 ) . A natural next step is to provide a portfolio of complementary optimizers and let the agent select or combine them according to the task and current search state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，优化工具的价值与其是否匹配任务更为相关，而非其独立时的强大程度。 近期的智能体优化系统已开始将数值后端暴露为智能体可以选择性查询和控制的工具（Brunzema 等人，2026）。 一个自然的下一步是提供一组互补的优化器，并让智能体根据任务和当前的搜索状态来选择或组合它们。

sents.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，优化工具的价值与其是否匹配任务更为相关，而非其独立时的强大程度。

paragraphs.en: Task information can substantially affect optimization, but richer prior knowledge is useful only when it can guide concrete search decisions. Recent LLM-based optimizers have shown that natural-language priors and retrieved domain knowledge can be incorporated directly into optimization ( Brunzema et al., 2026 ; Maus et al., 2026 ) . Future agents could go further by actively identifying and acquiring useful priors, such as important variables, interactions, or promising search regions.
paragraphs.zh: 任务信息会对优化产生显著影响，但更丰富的先验知识只有在能够指导具体的搜索决策时才有用。 近期的基于大型语言模型的优化器表明，自然语言形式的先验知识和检索到的领域知识可以直接融入优化过程（Brunzema 等人，2026；Maus 等人，2026）。 未来的智能体可以更进一步，通过主动识别和获取有用的先验知识（例如重要变量、相互作用或潜在的搜索区域）来实现这一目标。

sents.en: Recent LLM-based optimizers have shown that natural-language priors and retrieved domain knowledge can be incorporated directly into optimization ( Brunzema et al., 2026 ; Maus et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Our handoff experiments show that continued LLM control is not always necessary once a useful search trajectory has been established. Related hybrid approaches have similarly combined LLM-guided exploration with statistical optimization later in the search ( Chang et al., 2025 ) . This motivates cost-aware routing that decides when additional LLM reasoning is worth its computational cost.

paragraphs.en: A general-purpose optimization agent should not need to start from scratch on every new problem. Recent work has explored using previous optimization trajectories or agent executions as reusable experience ( Ran et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: For each family, we run three independent development sessions starting from the same GP-EI implementation (v0). Each session submits six revisions (v1–v6), evaluated on four development tasks with seeds 0 and 1. BBOB development uses f01, f08, f12, and f21; HPO development uses Iris/SVM, Digits/SVM, Wine/RF, and Digits/RF. The selected programs are then frozen and evaluated on the disjoint held-out tasks f02/f15 for BBOB and Breast/SVM/Diabetes/RF for HPO, using seeds 2–5. This gives 48 held-out deployments in total. All six selected programs contribute to the reported mean; held-out performance is never used for selection, and no LLM calls are made during deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个数据集，我们从相同的 GP-EI 实现（v0）开始运行三个独立的发展会话。 每个会话提交六个修订版本（v1–v6），并在种子为 0 和 1 的情况下通过四个发展任务进行评估。 BBOB 发展使用 f01、f08、f12 和 f21；HPO 发展使用 Iris/SVM、Digits/SVM、Wine/RF 和 Digits/RF。 随后，选定的程序被冻结，并在 BBOB 的互斥保留任务 f02/f15 以及 HPO 的 Breast/SVM/Diabetes/RF 上进行评估，使用种子 2–5。 这样总共得到 48 个保留部署。 所有六个选定的程序都对报告的平均值有贡献；保留性能从未用于选择，并且在部署过程中没有进行任何 LLM 调用。

paragraphs.en: These results show that optimizer development can improve over the fixed GP baseline, but transfer to disjoint tasks is not uniformly reliable in this setting. The variation may reflect sensitivity to the particular development tasks rather than a general limitation of offline optimizer development. With only three sessions per family, the result should therefore be viewed as descriptive evidence rather than a causal claim about overfitting or any individual design choice.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，优化器开发相较于固定的 GP 基线模型可以得到改进，但在此设定中，将其迁移到不相关的任务上并非始终可靠。 这种差异可能反映了模型对特定开发任务的敏感性，而非离线优化器开发的普遍局限性。 由于每个家族仅包含三个会话，因此该结果应被视为描述性证据，而非关于过拟合或任何具体设计选择的因果性论断。
